newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba, Sandoz set Novartis news conference, shares up.
newsitem.headline: Ciba, Sandoz set Novartis news conference, shares up.

text.p: Swiss pharmaceutical groups Ciba-Geigy and Sandoz scheduled a news conference for 1500 GMT on Tuesday about their planned merger into the world's number two pharmaceuticals firm, Novartis.
In Zurich shares in both companies rose after the announcement.
"We expect news on the merger of Ciba and Sandoz into Novartis during the course of the afternoon," the two compnaies said in a joint statement.

No comment was immediately available from the two groups on whether the expected news was U.S. regulatory approval, which is the last major obstacle to concluding the merger as planned by the end of this year.
Ciba registered shares rose 11 Swiss francs to 1,638 and then slipped back to around 1,630, a gain of three francs over Monday's close.
Sandoz bearer shares added 10 Swiss francs to 1,539 and then also eased back to 1,531, two francs above the overnight price.
